summary: Old Second Bancorp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 on October 1, 2026, announcing it will release third-quarter 2026 financial results after market close on October 21, 2026, and host an earnings call on October 22 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern. The filing provides only webcast and replay details on the investor relations site. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural/regulatory terms are stated. This is a routine earnings-scheduling notice, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
